fields.description: The OS app this workspace belongs to (its dock package). The window's identity is (app, workspace_id); the app owns the dock, the workspace owns the window (ADR-0042).
fields.label: App

fields.description: The immutable slug that identifies this workspace inside its app (ADR-0042). Unique per app, seeded from the module name (Selling → selling). It is the workspace in window ids, URLs, and 'when: { workspace: ... }' menu gates; a rename touches only Label, so open windows and saved URLs survive. Never changed after creation.
fields.label: Workspace Id

fields.description: The workspace name shown in the app hub's sidebar. Editable — renaming touches only this, not the identity slug (ADR-0042).
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The source module this workspace was seeded from (ADR-0042). The seeder keys insert-if-missing on (App, Module), so this is the anchor that survives migrate. Empty for a user-added workspace, which the seeder never touches.
fields.label: Module

fields.description: The order this workspace appears in the app hub's sidebar (lower first). Seeded from the module's position in the app; the user can re-order, and re-order survives migrate (ADR-0042).
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: A seeded workspace the user removed. Removal is a flag, not a delete, so the insert-if-missing seeder never resurrects it (ADR-0042). Hidden rows are excluded from the boot payload.
fields.label: Hidden

fields.description: The workspace the app hub opens by default and whose overview fills the hub's main section (ADR-0042). Exactly one row per app carries this; the manifest's default_workspace declares it, the seeder stamps it, and a site may re-point it.
fields.label: Default
